source.authority: local browser target-provider cache candidate; no RCL Core promotion, production cache admission, main-branch mutation or release claim

pipeline: sealed explicit audio-target binding -> existing VSR browser asset cache -> existing VSRSpatialAssetStreamer(kind=audio) -> SHA-256 verified bytes and receipt root -> Web Audio decodeAudioData -> scheduled target receipt

canonicalSeam.worldSemantics: RSR and Experience Fabric continue to own cue identity, fixed-tick timing, spatial parameters, listener meaning and offline audio semantics.
canonicalSeam.assetResidency: VSR owns the existing CacheStorage-backed content-addressed asset cache, revision root, SHA verification, bounded bytes and cache diagnostics.
canonicalSeam.targetProvider: Reality Build reuses the VSR browser cache and VSRSpatialAssetStreamer before handing verified bytes to the existing Web Audio buffer Provider.
canonicalSeam.policyBoundary: Experience Fabric maxVoices, cue maxInstances/cooldown and audio-bus/render policy are not copied into the browser target.
canonicalSeam.rclBoundary: This is an auxiliary target-provider cache reuse seam, not an RCL Core promotion.

webChromium.claimBoundary: Chromium observed cache write, same-runtime cache hit, cold-reload cache hit, VSR asset residency, Web Audio decode and target scheduling; this is not audible output or human listening proof.

commands: local Chromium candidate execution through Playwright
first load with empty browser cache, same-runtime revisit and cold reload

localTestSummary.browser: exact WAV request 200; first-load cache miss/write; cold-reload cache hit; VSR ready=1, failed=0, blocked=0; Web Audio decode=1/1; page errors=0

verification.expectedResult: All listed local checks pass; no hosted CI, Android/native audio, physical-device output or human-listening result is inferred.

stressCase: A fixed-tick RSR audio event must reuse the generic VSR browser cache across target reloads while preserving revision-root identity, SHA-verified bytes, receipt roots and explicit audio binding.
donorAdvantage: VSR already supplies a CacheStorage-backed content-addressed cache with revision invalidation and diagnostics; the audio target reuses it instead of adding a parallel audio cache.
regressionCase: First load records one miss and write; repeated same-runtime access hits the existing bytes; cold reload rehydrates the same revision and manifest without a second audio request; VSR and Web Audio receipts remain linked.
boundaries: The cache is asset residency reuse only; it is not continuous or segmented audio streaming.
No target-side max-voice cap, mixer, bus graph, authored concurrency policy or latency budget was introduced or verified.
The cache byte budget and hit behavior are one local Chromium run, not a quota guarantee or cross-device performance curve.
No Android/native audio output, speaker/headphone routing, physical-device behavior, release signing, store delivery or human listening acceptance is claimed by this browser evidence.
No K400 gate is promoted to PASS.
nextCandidate: Retain the shared cache contract and separately determine whether Android quota/eviction/performance or target-side voice/mixer/continuous-stream policy has a canonical owner; physical-device listening remains a separate human gate.
